Contact Us for Professional Portable Restroom Services

Your events deserve the best sanitation solutions. Choose Clean Restroom Rentals for reliable service.

About Clean Restroom Rental Virginia

Clean Restroom Rentals is Virginia’s trusted leader in portable restroom and hand-washing station rentals. With over 22 years of experience, we serve locations from Richmond to Virginia Beach, delivering clean, comfortable facilities for every event or job site. Whether you're hosting a wedding, festival, or sports tournament—or managing a residential, commercial, or industrial construction project—our professional team ensures dependable service and spotless sanitation. Across the Commonwealth—from farmlands to fairgrounds—Clean Restroom Rentals keeps communities, crews, and guests refreshed and ready for what’s next.

Why Choose Us?

  • Quality Service Delivery: We pride ourselves on providing top-tier sanitation solutions tailored to your needs.
  • Customer Satisfaction: Our commitment is to ensure every client is satisfied with our services, guaranteed.
  • Experienced Professionals: Our team consists of knowledgeable experts ready to assist you at every step of the rental process.

Our Services & Products

Standard Unit

Our basic units include a toilet, urinal, toilet paper holder, and hand sanitizer dispenser. Designed for maximum ventilation and privacy, they come with anti-slip flooring and are serviced weekly.

Luxury Flushing Unit

Elevate your event with our luxury units that feature a flushing toilet, sink with hands-free water dispensing, soap, and paper towel dispensers.

Wheelchair-Accessible Handicap Unit

Ensure accessibility with our OSHA-compliant handicap units, providing non-flushing options with maximum ventilation.

Wash Station

Our portable hand wash stations come fully stocked with soap and paper towels, featuring hands-free water dispensing for convenience and compliance with health regulations.

Crane Unit

Ideal for high-rise projects, our crane units are easily attachable to any standard unit, designed for ease of installation and use.

Office Trailer System

The perfect addition to your job site, our office trailer system offers clean fresh water and waste solutions with customizable configurations.

Luxury Restroom Trailers

Choose from various models, including our 2-Stall, 4-Stall, and 10-Stall trailers, ensuring comfort and convenience for large gatherings.

Our Commitment to You

  • Experienced Professionals: Our team has the expertise to handle any event, large or small.
  • Customer Satisfaction Guaranteed: We strive to exceed your expectations with every interaction.
  • Licensed and Insured: Rest easy knowing you are working with a reputable and responsible provider.
  • Competitive Pricing: Enjoy high-quality service at prices that fit your budget.

Ready to Get Started?

Choose Clean Restroom Rentals for your next event or project. We guarantee timely and reliable service to meet all your sanitation needs.

Contact us today for a free quote!
